overview: The Gate District is the doctrinal threshold of Sanctus Seru, where all entry is screened, scanned, and regulated.
history: Constructed as the first fortified expansion of Seru’s authoritarian rule.
Purity-screened gates were added to prevent ideological contamination.
Resonance scanning pylons were introduced to detect magical anomalies.
Praetorian checkpoint towers were integrated to enforce decree compliance.
hooks: A scanning pylon detects an unexplained resonance signature.
A purity gate experiences a doctrinal flare.
A Praetorian gate officer requests assistance with a sealed edict.
A traveler disappears after failing purity screening.
